about_the_game:
STOCKWAVE ONLINE is an action-packed, player-vs-player free-for-all about beating up your co-workers over the Stock Market. Trading is not safe in the modern day, as the local employees of big-stonk fight over any liquidated penny they can find.

STOCKWAVE ONLINE Provides a unique online multiplayer experience about a violent enterprise of repossessing your colleagues' stocks, while defending your own precious assets. Buy and trade these in for cash, and become the most diligent Stock Trader in the Pure Liquid Exchange Bureau.

Cash is made in from the global stock market. A system of reputation and randomness, requiring strategy to manipulate and overcome. Managing shares correctly is key to making the fortune that every Wolf of Wall Street wannabe wants. Buy, sell, and steal your way to wealth, and the prestigious "Employee Of The Month" award.

Scavenging the synthwave-inspired landscape for resources, traders craft tools using whatever they can find to try initiate or survive deadly confrontations. Aggressive slapstick violence rules the halls of these establishments, so be prepared for a fight. It's only you, and your capital, against the war-torn world of investment.

Features:

Players get thrust into an inescapable office environment with a goal: Be the wealthiest worker there. Buy and Sell stocks to earn cash, with the hopes of making more money than your co-workers. So buy low, and sell high. The problems arise when other players get violent, since there only you stand in the way between your oppositions murdering you in cold blood for your stocks. They will try to take the whole pot. The more you invest, the more they can take.

Everyone gets access to the stock-traders web, where you can buy and sell your acquired assets. Wait for a stockwave event to hit, and the stock prices progress using a hidden reputation system. This is the core of money making, along with protecting these purchased stocks from any prying hands trying to leverage them from you. The best stock-trader by the end can claim the title of: "Employee of the Month", and a hefty bonus.

STOCKWAVE ONLINE uses a fast-paced and high-octane combat system. Getting you deeply involved in the blood and sweat of action. Use the tools around you to batter enemies across the map, and stain the environment around you in your success. It isn't the prettiest sight, but nothing can stand in the way of fortune.

Collect resources in the environment to craft and utilize weapons of mass destruction. Build up defenses with traps, blockages and survival gear. Or, craft up a strategy to hunt, and kill the competition for their spoils. A large loot list allows intricate strategies to be created and played out in an expansive tile-based world.

We built around strategies and play-styles. Balancing systems to make a variety different approaches viable in the long-term. Along with completely random stock-trading effects and item rotations, all games put the players on a level playing field, focusing on what you decide to do with the world around you. Take advantage of these elements, and take 

Up to 8 players across the globe can join a stock shift at a time. Leading to a chaotic free-for-all experience. Fist your friends across different maps and game-modes in from the comfort of your own home, or take on a class of strangers and assert your name as the greatest foe of all trader-kind.

With that extra cash from your "Employee of the month" checks, you may want to head down the stores and buy some cosmetics. (Using the earn-able in-game currency). Earn and open briefcases in game to unlock new suits, hats, sprays and more! Use them in-game to show off your swagger and wealth.

Fulfill the economy! Become a stock-trader today!
